mode.major: A tonal candidate with a major third and leading tone. Cadence, rhythm and register affect its character.
mode.minor: A minor-third candidate. Emphasizing the leading tone in V or V7 can strengthen tension and resolution.
mode.dorian: A mode combining a minor third with a major sixth.
mode.phrygian: A mode characterized by a minor third and lowered second.
mode.lydian: A mode characterized by a major third and raised fourth.
mode.mixolydian: A mode with a major third and lowered seventh.
mode.locrian: A mode with a minor third and diminished fifth, giving the tonic triad less stability.
analysis.empty: No melody input; the generated base plan is retained.
keys.empty: No melody input; no key or mode candidates.
warning.sparse: Sparse melody: tonal evidence is limited; several keys may fit.
warning.keyChanges: Key changes present: ranking is an aggregate, inspect each section separately.
keys.heading: Heuristic compatibility; not statistical probability.
harmony.heading: Compatibility is heuristic, not probability.
harmony.explanation: Melody fit {fit:.3f}; cadence bonus {cadence:.2f}; root-motion proxy {motion:.2f} semitones. {evidence}/{bars} bars have melody evidence. One chord per bar; non-chord tones may be intentional.
score.unaligned: Voices have different bar boundaries and are displayed separately.
score.fractional: Durations without standard notation are shown as diamonds with whole-note fractions.
compose.noAnchors: No active melody anchors; base plan unchanged.
compose.context: CONTEXT: {count} original key/meter markers retained at exact onsets
compose.tempoWarning: {section}: anchor/base tempos differ; symbolic beat rhythm retained at base tempo
compose.similarity: Motif similarity {overall:.3f}; contour {contour:.3f}; rhythm {rhythm:.3f}; important notes {important:.3f}; ending retained={ending}; seed={seed}
compose.variation: VARIATION changed {count} notes; protected-only motifs remain unchanged.
compose.irregular: Irregular meter: conventional pulse grid protected; additive grouping not inferred.
compose.noSuggestion: HARMONY SUGGESTION: no retained melody notes after fitting
theme.heading: MAIN THEME
theme.motif: Complete motif: {size} bars; voice: {voice}; no section names required.
theme.statements: First statement preserves the motif; later compatible statements use limited variation.
theme.preserved: Only listed measure ranges are replaced; section names and the remaining generated score are retained.
transcribe.original: TRANSCRIPTION: original audio; no recovery applied.
transcribe.recovered: TRANSCRIPTION WARNING: the original SheetSage2 export failed. Retried once with {seconds:.3f} s trailing silence; the input waveform was not changed. No note events were rounded or discarded by HumComposer. The model transcribed again and may infer extra notes or bars, including in the padding. Review the recovered ABC before relying on it. Original error: {error}
generate.verified: BASE PLAN: required audio sections and melody placement verified.
